name: Ballard Ambassador Interpretation Benchmark
purpose: Keep Ballard decision-first while making the place immediately understandable through concise, accurate, observation-led interpretation.

dimensions.name: Immediate comprehension — what is this place?
Connects boats, water control and salmon into one system
Translates live conditions into visitor experience

acceptanceRules: Every added block must orient, explain, direct attention, or interpret a live signal.
The main page must preserve the live decision and best-first-stop above the interpretive layer.
Every core tour stop must answer: See this, What's happening, Watch for, Why it matters, Right now.
AIS positions must never be described as guaranteed lock transits or ETAs.
Seasonal salmon counts must not be presented as guaranteed viewing.
Operational facts must remain sourced to current public authorities and freshness-limited where needed.
Avoid generic tourism praise; show the interesting thing and let the visitor form the judgment.
Prefer a concrete observation prompt over another explanatory paragraph.
